s1.heading: 1. Who we are
s1.body: FastGet is (“we”, “us”, “our”), registered at Office no - 17, 2nd Floor, Bhavan's Campus, Sardar Patel Technology Business Incubator, Old D N Nagar, Munshi Nagar, Andheri West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400058. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect through the FastGet website and mobile app, how we use it, and the choices you have.

s2.heading: 2. Information we collect
s2.intro: When you create an account, place an order, or contact support, we collect:
list: Account details: name, email address, phone number, and password (stored as a one-way hash, never in plain text)
Delivery addresses you save to your account

Delivery site details: the site address and pincode, and - only if you tap "Use my current location" at checkout - your phone's location at that moment, saved with the order so our delivery team can find the site. If you add GST details at checkout, we save the GSTIN and business name to print on your invoice.
Order history: items purchased, order status, and invoices
Communications you send us (e.g. support requests)

Usage information: pages you open, products you view, searches, taps, errors you run into, and whether you use the app or a browser. We may also make session recordings of how the app is used. What you type, and your name, address and phone number, are hidden in these recordings.
s2.outro: If you allow notifications, the app also stores a push token for your phone so we can send you order updates. We do not collect your contacts, and we only read your location when you tap "Use my current location" at checkout - never in the background. Apart from internet access, the app asks for two permissions: to show notifications, and to use your location for that checkout button. You can refuse either, or turn them off at any time in your phone's settings - you can still type your address instead.

s3.heading: 3. How we use your information
list: To create and manage your account and process orders
To send order confirmations, delivery updates (by email and app notification), and verification/password-reset emails
To improve and secure our service
To understand how the app is used, for example where people get stuck or leave, so we can fix problems and make it easier to use

s4.heading: 4. Sharing with third parties
s4.intro: We share the minimum information necessary with the following service providers, who act on our behalf:
s4.razorpay: processes your payments (cards, UPI, net banking). Razorpay receives your payment details directly; FastGet never stores your card or UPI credentials.
s4.resend: delivers transactional emails (signup verification, password reset, order updates) on our behalf.
s4.cloudinary: hosts product images; no personal information is sent to Cloudinary.
s4.neon: stores our application database, including your account and order data, on infrastructure hosted in AWS ap-southeast-1.
s4.push: deliver order-update notifications to the FastGet app. They receive your phone's push token and the notification text (such as your order status and amount), and nothing else about you.
s4.posthog: provides product analytics. It receives the usage information and session recordings described above, linked to a random identifier or your account ID. It never receives your name, email address or phone number. Data is stored in the United States.
s4.outro: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
s4.whatsapp: if you choose to chat with us on WhatsApp, your messages are handled by WhatsApp under its own privacy policy. We only see what you send us in the chat.
s4.maps: our delivery team may open a delivery site's pinned location in Google Maps to find the way. Only the location of the site is opened, not your name or phone number.

s5.heading: 5. Cookies and local storage
s5.body: We use a secure, encrypted session cookie to keep you signed in, and store your cart and wishlist locally on your device so they persist between visits. Our analytics provider, PostHog, also stores a random identifier on your device so we can understand how FastGet is used. None of these are used for advertising or cross-site tracking.

s6.heading: 6. Data retention
s6.body: We retain your account and order data for as long as your account is active, or as required to comply with legal, tax, and accounting obligations. Session recordings are deleted automatically after 30 days, and analytics data after at most 12 months. You can request deletion at any time as described below.

s7.heading: 7. Your rights, including account deletion
s7.p1: You can review and update your saved addresses at any time from <account>Account</account> in the app. To permanently delete your account and associated data (addresses and wishlist), go to <deleteAccount>Account → Delete Account</deleteAccount> in the app or website and confirm with your password. This is available whether or not you have the app installed, by visiting our website. You can also request deletion by emailing <email>support@elemantra.in</email>.
s7.p2: Order records required for tax/accounting purposes may be retained as required by law even after account deletion.

s8.heading: 8. Security
s8.body: Passwords are stored using one-way hashing (bcrypt). Data in transit is encrypted via HTTPS. Session cookies are HTTP-only and signed. Access to the production database is restricted to authorized personnel.

s9.heading: 9. Children's privacy
s9.body: FastGet is intended for business and contractor use and is not directed at children under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

s10.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
s10.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the “Last updated” date above.

s11.heading: 11. Contact us
s11.body: For privacy questions or data requests, contact us at <email>support@elemantra.in</email> or call +91 7045737058. FastGet, Office no - 17, 2nd Floor, Bhavan's Campus, Sardar Patel Technology Business Incubator, Old D N Nagar, Munshi Nagar, Andheri West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400058.

s1.heading: 1. Order cancellations
s1.body: Because FastGet delivers urgently within 60 minutes, orders can typically only be cancelled for a full refund before they are dispatched for delivery. Once an order is out for delivery, it can no longer be cancelled.

s2.heading: 2. Damaged, defective, or wrong items
s2.body: If you receive damaged, defective, or incorrect items, contact us within 24 hours of delivery at <email>support@elemantra.in</email> with your order number and photos of the issue. We will arrange a replacement or a full refund for the affected items.

s3.heading: 3. Non-returnable items
s3.body: Due to the nature of building materials (cut-to-size items, custom orders, and bulk/loose materials), items that are not defective and have been delivered correctly are not eligible for return once accepted.

s4.heading: 4. Refund method and timeline
s4.body: Approved refunds are issued to your original payment method via Razorpay. Refunds typically reflect in your account within 5–7 business days, depending on your bank or payment provider.

s5.heading: 5. How to request a refund
s5.body: Email <email>support@elemantra.in</email> or visit the Support page in the app with your order number and a brief description of the issue.

s1.heading: 1. Service area
s1.body: FastGet currently delivers to construction sites and businesses across Mumbai.

s2.heading: 2. Delivery time
s2.body: Most orders are delivered within 60 minutes of confirmation, subject to traffic, order size, and stock availability. You can track your order's status from <account>Account → Order History</account>.

s3.heading: 3. Delivery charges
s3.body: Delivery charges, if any, are shown at checkout before you complete payment.

s4.heading: 4. Failed or delayed delivery
s4.body: If our delivery agent is unable to reach you or the delivery address, we will attempt to contact you using the phone number on your order. Significant delays will be communicated via email or in-app order status updates.
